comment: Read from src/Chroma at commit 37a37b0, the commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.2.3, alongside the plugin's wiki page for Chroma. The module declares no parameters, inputs or outputs at all, so there is nothing to tag and no props to give. Its behaviour lives in a display widget and in the plugin settings menu. The wiki's Global settings section lists the key mappings, the latch-colour option and the port hover mode, which are all in the plugin settings submenu rather than on the module's own menu.
